scope: Independent file-only audit of teacher-forced original-NPU-input two-layer replay; not model qualification

integrity.serialized_config_difference: runner omits exactly one trailing newline; parsed JSON and all other bytes identical

limitations: Only two prompts; first three system windows share input hashes. Two first-token rows are duplicate underlying example.
Candidate receives original NPU hidden/KV at each window: candidate errors do not propagate between windows.
First-chunk nonfirst rows may inherit preceding first-token error through within-block attention; this is not isolated normal-row quantization error.
The range16 edit does not solve first-token outliers. Slightly larger subsequent local errors than old I16 are measured here, not a general ranking.
API-only timings exclude load/conversion and explicit cache flush/invalidate. Two timed repeats per input, no speech/RAG, no full-model TTFT or semantic test.
Overall CPU is whole-board busy fraction over this short diagnostic; no PSS/process-memory attribution.
